pois.name: Central Park
pois.address: Central Park, Manhattan, New York, NY, USA
pois.description: World-famous 843-acre urban park in the heart of Manhattan featuring Bethesda Terrace, Bow Bridge, the Ramble, and Sheep Meadow.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic Manhattan green oasis and essential orientation landmark
✓ Beautiful landscape architecture with sprawling historic trails
pois.tip: Rent a rowboat at the Loeb Boathouse or stroll through the peaceful Ramble woodlands.

provenance.place_verification: Central Park Conservancy Official Landmark Registry

pois.name: Empire State Building
pois.address: 20 W 34th St, New York, NY 10001, USA
pois.description: Historic 102-story Art Deco skyscraper in Midtown Manhattan offering panoramic 360-degree open-air views across New York City.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-renowned 360-degree observation deck
✓ Masterpiece of Art Deco architecture and global symbol of New York
pois.tip: Reserve the 86th floor open-air observatory an hour before sunset for spectacular day-to-night transitions.

provenance.place_verification: Empire State Realty Trust Official Registry

pois.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
pois.description: One of the world's greatest art museums, housing over two million works spanning five thousand years of world culture on Museum Mile.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-class cultural institution with Egyptian Temple of Dendur and European masterpieces
✓ Prime Museum Mile location along Central Park
pois.tip: Closed on Wednesdays. Visit the Iris and B. Gerald Cantor Roof Garden for panoramic views of Central Park.

pois.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island
pois.address: Liberty Island & Ellis Island, New York Harbor, NY, USA
pois.description: Colossal neoclassical sculpture on Liberty Island and the historic National Museum of Immigration on Ellis Island in New York Harbor.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Universal symbol of freedom and UNESCO World Heritage cultural monument
✓ Scenic ferry voyage with sweeping harbor and Manhattan skyline views
pois.tip: Catch the Statue City Cruises ferry from Battery Park. Reserve pedastal access weeks in advance.

provenance.place_verification: National Park Service (NPS) World Heritage Registry
provenance.price_source: Authorized Statue City Cruises Reserve Ticket ($24.50 USD)

pois.name: Top of the Rock (Rockefeller Center)
pois.address: 30 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10112, USA
pois.description: Multi-tier observation deck atop 30 Rockefeller Plaza offering sweeping, unobstructed views of Central Park and the Empire State Building.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Clearest unobstructed midtown view of the Empire State Building and Central Park
✓ Art Deco historic complex with ice rink, NBC Studios, and public art
pois.tip: The 70th-floor open-air deck has no glass partitions, ideal for photography.

pois.name: The High Line
pois.address: The High Line (Gansevoort St to 34th St), New York, NY, USA
pois.description: 1.45-mile elevated public park, greenway, and rail trail built on a historic freight rail line above Manhattan's West Side.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-class adaptive urban park with contemporary art installations
✓ Scenic elevated vantage points over Chelsea and the Hudson River
pois.tip: Walk south from Hudson Yards towards Chelsea Market and the Meatpacking District.

provenance.place_verification: Friends of the High Line / NYC Parks Registry

pois.name: Brooklyn Bridge
pois.address: Brooklyn Bridge, New York, NY 10038, USA
pois.description: Iconic 1883 hybrid cable-stayed/suspension bridge spanning the East River between Lower Manhattan and Brooklyn.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Historic 19th-century engineering marvel and National Historic Landmark
✓ Elevated pedestrian walkway with dramatic skyline views over Lower Manhattan
pois.tip: Walk from Brooklyn towards Manhattan in the late afternoon for the best skyline views and sunset golden hour.

provenance.place_verification: NYC Department of Transportation Landmark Registry

pois.name: Times Square & Broadway Theatre District
pois.address: Times Square, Broadway & 7th Ave, New York, NY 10036, USA
pois.description: Bustling commercial intersection, entertainment center, and tourist hub illuminated by giant digital billboards at the heart of Broadway.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ The vibrant electrical epicenter of Manhattan's entertainment culture
✓ Hub of world-renowned Broadway theaters and pedestrian plazas
pois.tip: Visit the red TKTS staircase in the evening to experience the full brilliance of the illuminated billboards.

pois.name: 9/11 Memorial & Museum
pois.address: 180 Greenwich St, New York, NY 10007, USA
pois.description: Solemn memorial featuring twin reflecting pools situated in the footprints of the original Twin Towers and an underground museum.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Deeply moving memorial to the victims with the largest manmade waterfalls in North America
✓ Architectural harmony with One World Trade Center and the Oculus
pois.tip: Outdoor Memorial Plaza is free to enter; museum requires timed tickets (closed Tuesdays).

provenance.price_source: Museum General Admission ($33.00 USD), Outdoor Memorial Free

pois.name: Grand Central Terminal
pois.address: 89 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017, USA
pois.description: Historic Beaux-Arts transportation hub celebrated for its astronomical ceiling mural, four-faced brass clock, and Whispering Gallery.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Masterpiece of Beaux-Arts civic architecture
✓ Iconic celestial constellation ceiling and historic dining concourse
pois.tip: Test the acoustic acoustics at the Whispering Gallery archway right outside the Grand Central Oyster Bar.

pois.name: Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
pois.address: 11 W 53rd St, New York, NY 10019, USA
pois.description: World-leading modern art museum featuring masterpieces such as Van Gogh's The Starry Night, Dalí's The Persistence of Memory, and Warhol's Campbell's Soup Cans.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unmatched collection of modern and contemporary masterworks
✓ Serene Abby Aldrich Rockefeller Sculpture Garden
pois.tip: Head to the 5th floor first to see Starry Night before gallery crowds peak.

pois.name: Summit One Vanderbilt
pois.address: 45 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017, USA
pois.description: Immersive multi-sensory observation deck featuring infinite mirrored rooms, glass ledges, and sweeping views directly adjacent to Grand Central Terminal.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Groundbreaking art and reflection observation experience
✓ Spectacular up-close perspective on the Chrysler Building and Empire State Building
pois.tip: Sunglasses are highly recommended due to intense mirrored reflections during bright sunny days.

pois.name: Fifth Avenue & St. Patrick's Cathedral
pois.address: 5th Ave (49th to 59th St), New York, NY, USA
pois.description: World-famous avenue of premier architecture, cultural flagships, and the magnificent neo-Gothic St. Patrick's Cathedral.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Stunning neo-Gothic marble cathedral soaring amidst Midtown skyscrapers
✓ Iconic Manhattan shopping and architectural boulevard
pois.tip: Step inside St. Patrick's Cathedral to admire the massive stained glass rose windows and serene sanctuary.

provenance.place_verification: Archdiocese of New York / NYC Landmark Registry

pois.name: Chelsea Market
pois.description: Historic indoor food hall and retail concourse housed in the former Nabisco biscuit factory where the Oreo was invented.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Artisan food stalls, gourmet eateries, and independent boutique shops
✓ Direct access to the elevated High Line walkway
pois.tip: Try fresh steamed lobster at the Lobster Place or tacos at Los Tacos No. 1.

pois.name: Katz's Delicatessen
pois.address: 205 E Houston St, New York, NY 10002, USA
pois.description: Legendary kosher-style deli established in 1888 on the Lower East Side, famous for hand-carved pastrami on rye.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Authentic New York culinary institution operating since 1888
✓ Universally celebrated hot pastrami and corned beef sandwiches
pois.tip: Hold onto your paper ticket given at the door; you must hand it to the cashier when leaving even if empty.
pois.signature_dish: Hand-Carved Hot Pastrami on Rye with Deli Mustard

provenance.price_source: A la carte pastrami sandwich (~$27.95 USD)

pois.name: Joe's Pizza (Greenwich Village)
pois.address: 7 Carmine St, New York, NY 10014, USA
pois.description: Greenwich Village classic slice shop founded in 1975 by Italian immigrant Joe Pozzuoli, serving quintessential New York thin-crust pizza.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ The gold standard of traditional New York thin-crust cheese pizza
✓ Classic Greenwich Village counter experience
pois.tip: Order a plain cheese slice or fresh mozzarella slice hot out of the deck oven.
pois.signature_dish: Classic New York Plain Cheese Pizza Slice

provenance.place_verification: Joe's Pizza Official Greenwich Village Registry

pois.name: Keens Steakhouse
pois.address: 72 W 36th St, New York, NY 10018, USA
pois.description: Historic Midtown steakhouse established in 1885 featuring the world's largest collection of churchwarden smoking pipes.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Legendary 1885 Manhattan dining hall with antique woodwork
✓ Renowned for its legendary mutton chop and dry-aged prime steaks
pois.tip: Reserve tables in advance; the historic pub room is more casual and accepts walk-ins.
pois.signature_dish: Our Famous Mutton Chop & Prime Porterhouse

provenance.price_source: A la carte dining (~$65.00 USD average dinner)

pois.name: Levain Bakery
pois.address: 167 W 74th St, New York, NY 10023, USA
pois.description: Beloved Upper West Side bakery world-famous for its massive six-ounce warm cookies and artisan baked breads.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Nationally acclaimed six-ounce molten-center cookies
✓ Perfect sweet stop after exploring Central Park
pois.tip: The chocolate chip walnut cookie is the original signature recipe.
pois.signature_dish: Signature Six-Ounce Chocolate Chip Walnut Cookie
